about: The shipped versions of the reviewed lexicon supplement (quality/lexicon_supplement.py). A version is FROZEN: its file is never edited, and a new batch is a new row with a new file. `default` is the version a NEW run declares; a saved run keeps the id and sha256 it was graded under, and an id or file that no longer matches refuses (LEXICON_SUPPLEMENT_UNAVAILABLE) rather than reading another version.

versions.shipped: PR #522, 2026-10-10: 203 readings of 135 tens-unit number compounds (rule:number-compound)
2026-10-10: frozen v1 plus reviewed streetlight (Moby attestation) and streetlights (finite plural derivation); opt-in, default remains v1
